newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam trade deficit down, inflation up.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam trade deficit down, inflation up.

text.p: Vietnam's General Statistics Office reported on Thursday that the trade deficit for the first seven months of this year was expected to reach $1.77 billion, representing a fall from the same period in 1996.
Data released by the office also showed that year-on-year inflation had risen to 3.1 percent in July while industrial output was up 14.1 percent.
The figures showed first seven month imports at $6.633 billion, representing a fall of 2.3 percent from the same period last year, while exports rose 25.2 percent to $4.863 billion.
